dims: block or refuse an available fix
resource aligned needs, skip greater ones
create or deepen a crisis in a target population
Cuba oil blockade; Venezuela pre-capture pressure
anchors: Sued his own IRS for $10B, settled with his own DOJ: apology + no damages + IRS forever barred from auditing Trump, his family, or their companies. The fund itself — DOJ testified it will not proceed. The realized capture is the audit-bar, which holds regardless of the fund.
A real crisis, but selected because the beneficiary is aligned (Milei); ~$2.5B drawn, repaid Dec 2025. Fails the fabrication test; scores on selective-allocation, not extraction.

200+ killed, 60+ boats; targets cocaine routes while fentanyl enters overland; no congressional authorization; war-crime suits. No financial capture — so S7 (assets/lives/legality), not S6. Gravest case; scored on documented effectiveness/legality gaps only.
Pre-capture pressure (S8) → Maduro capture Jan 3 2026 (S7) → Venezuelan oil routed into U.S.-controlled accounts (S6). Not a bailout — the flow is extraction.
Tanker blockade from Feb 2026; ~11,000 children awaiting suspended surgery, infant mortality up to 9.9/1000, UN warns children dying. Scored on major-proximate-cause contribution, not sole cause.

2024 bipartisan fix killed (S3) → sustained crisis → +~$170B enforcement/detention captured by the private-detention architecture (S6, cell B040). "Entire system manufactured" overreaches — migration itself is not US-made.

S3.name: Anti-remediation
S3.measures: How resistance to correction varies with the cost of the fix — the signature is resisting cheap or even negative-cost fixes.
test: Cheap / transparency fixes resisted as hard as expensive ones?
S3.control: a genuinely under-resourced agency → positive cost-resistance slope (LOW)

S6.name: Selective-Allocation Asymmetry
S6.measures: Whether resource deployment tracks NEED or PAYOFF across the whole portfolio of crises.
test: Allocation decoupled / inverted vs need? (Spearman ρ)
Resourced set shares a capture or alignment payoff?
S6.control: COVID-19 ACIP vaccine allocation (2020) → LOW (tracked mortality risk)

S7.name: Asset / Standing Dissipation
S7.measures: Expenditure of force, lives, and legal legitimacy for a non-public, factional payoff under a manufactured pretext.
test: Net public value low vs the stated aim?
Factional / spectacle payoff rather than public-strategic?
S7.control: 1991 Gulf War → LOW (real threat, authorized, defined aim)

S8.name: Induced-Harm Coercion
S8.measures: Deliberate creation or deepening of a humanitarian crisis in a target population, used as a coercion lever.
test: Harm caused or materially deepened by deliberate action?
Harm falls on a civilian / non-combatant population?
Instrumentalized — tied to a coercive demand?
Obfuscated as something other than what it is?
S8.control: UNSCR 2664 / OFAC humanitarian licenses (2022) → LOW (carve-outs preserved)
